line: One camcorder tape, first person, an empty familiar interior where the camera's own failures carry the plot.
line_cn: 一盘摄像机录像带，第一人称，空荡熟悉的室内，摄像机自身的故障推动剧情。
lineage: Structure after lemo-opuscar STYLE.md (CC BY 4.0); text written for the H3 pipeline.
essence: One continuous first-person camcorder recording: VHS, 4:3 feel, handheld, dated on-screen display.
An empty, familiar-but-wrong interior that repeats: offices, hotel floors, pools, car parks.
Dread from emptiness, repetition and the machine failing: focus hunts, exposure pumps, tape tears.
Nothing chases anyone; nothing is explained.
not: Not a horror film: no monster close-ups, no jump-scare stings.
Not a CRT terminal piece: artefacts are tape and lens, not phosphor.
Not a ruin: clean and lit is part of the wrongness.
materials: VHS: chroma bleed, tracking noise, soft detail, a date-time stamp in the corner.
Fluorescent panels, drop ceilings, carpet, laminate; one material's sickly hue dominates.
Autofocus and auto-exposure that hunt and fail.

rules: One dominant sickly hue from the location's materials (mustard, institutional green, hospital blue).
Exactly one saturated colour: a signal lamp, an exit sign; it is the only thing that blooms.
White balance drifts; colour is never clean.
colour.examplePalette: wallpaper #d5bd66, trim #4d3d26, carpet #8c763c, fluorescent #f2f1e4, signal red #e0241c

type.titleFont: the camcorder's own OSD font (a blocky monospace), white with a dark edge
type.placement: OSD corners: REC top-left, date bottom-right; captions like [SILENCE] lower-left
rules: All on-screen text is OSD added by the assembler; the model draws none.
Handheld walking rhythm; the camera breathes with the operator.
Long holds; the dread is in the wait.
A tape tear is the only cut: same framing after, something changed.

grammar.note: slow, off a detail to the space
a glance down at the feet
into the distance with a focus hunt
camera set down on a surface, recording alone

framing: Any presence is small, far and in a region of dead lights.
forbiddenTransitions: anything the tape could not do

instruments: none; a drone of beating sines at most
sound.ambience: fluorescent hum (100 or 120 Hz plus harmonics), closer in small rooms
sound.silence: digital zero for a second or more, captioned [SILENCE]; everything restrikes at once after
sound.voice: the operator: a few short quiet lines with breath; a PA voice through a ceiling speaker

nativeMoves.name: Autofocus hunting
nativeMoves.what: Something is there only while focus is correct.
nativeMoves.build: zoom move, camera.note 'autofocus hunts', beat describing the far end going soft and sharp.
fits: a missing pet on a hotel floor
a figure in an empty stadium
a shape at the end of a ward

nativeMoves.name: Tape tear
nativeMoves.what: A tear is a cut the universe made: same framing, the clock jumped.
nativeMoves.build: jump_cut from the anchor; beats name what changed (a light died, the date advanced); assembler adds the tear noise.
fits: a lost weekend in a mall
a house that ages between tapes

nativeMoves.name: Camera set down
nativeMoves.what: The camera records alone on a surface.
nativeMoves.build: static shot, 15 s, beats 'nothing happens; a light flickers at 11 s'.

nativeMoves.name: Rules as text
nativeMoves.what: Notices drift wrong and finally address the viewer.
nativeMoves.build: insert shots of blank notice boards; the assembler overlays the text.

pitfalls.problem: The model makes it a clean horror movie with a creature.
pitfalls.fix: Negatives 'no monsters, no gore'; beats describe emptiness only.

pitfalls.problem: Footage is too sharp and colourful.
pitfalls.fix: texture vhs, grade muted; say 'soft VHS camcorder, chroma bleed' in the suffix.

pitfalls.problem: The operator's hands or face appear.
pitfalls.fix: pov angle; 'first person, no operator visible'.

look.genre: liminal found-footage camcorder tape, slow dread, no monsters
look.palette: one sickly institutional hue, near-white fluorescent panels, one saturated signal colour, drifting white balance
look.camera: handheld first-person camcorder, long holds, zooms that hunt focus
look.lens: camcorder wide, auto-focus and auto-exposure failing

engine.beatSuffix: Soft 1990s VHS camcorder footage, first person, empty fluorescent interior.

structures: a night-watch round that repeats three times, each time one thing missing
a search for an exit by following the signs, which start to lie
a camera left recording while the operator is away
openings: REC blinks on in a lift
a corridor at full walking pace
endings: the camera set down and left
a tear, then the same corridor dark
